act_thesis: Investigation becomes prediction, and the pressure acquires a will. Baz arrives as a person before he is a method (E16) and gathers evidence by consent (E17–E18). From Poydras (E20), unattributed hands take records and times and ask for nothing. Fear drives Seraphine and Lucien's first real fight (E21). Wrong theories are acted on and cost: Lucien's ground takes him and Elisabet into the pump station at night (E24) and costs her access and her season (E28); Seraphine keeps her account on the file at Metairie and learns a stranger asked for her minute (E25). Restraint is rewarded (E29), the night is paid (E30), and a grey case appears on Lucien's chalk after the event (E31). The signed page (E26) is right on time and place and wrong on the rest (E32); bodies come first, honesty costs Seraphine the block's trust, and Baz keeps a column from her (E33–E35). The act closes on a city adapting, Baz's bet that it is coming faster, and Lucien's false report, which Baz refuses (E36).

pressure_vectors.movement: scattered incidents → a working pattern → a falsifiable window → a partial hit with an expressive miss → a city adapting; "isolated event" stops being a useful frame. No global claim

external pressure acquires a will: records and times held or taken for someone "upstairs", a stranger at the family's door, an access letter revoked, grey cases that arrive after; it takes and never asks, and nobody says who. Ordinary sources (Denise, the pump supervisor, Caro's employer, Renita) keep their own motives

act_success_criteria: Baz is a person before a function (arrival pleasure, no clue in the meal, no death shadow), and has a friendship with Lucien independent of the case (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E16, S1.T1.B01.A2.E35)

Investigation happens while walking, eating and waiting; the recordings come by consent from their makers, and the order on them is there to hear with nobody certifying what it means (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E17, from v4.1b E19; D2, D3)
E18 is no lore council; Baz asks each friend what would prove them wrong; Seraphine's withheld disconfirmer is never narrated from inside her (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E18, from v4.1b E22)

E20: the city's interest acquires a will, unattributed: a room booked under no name, lanyards turned in, records held for "upstairs"; it takes and asks nothing; Elisabet enters on her own vector, on a visit, not for Caro and not for any institution (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E20, from v4.1b E23; VAA §3 T5, T8; Q-EN2)
E21: fear, not misunderstanding, drives the conflict; repair requires changed behaviour (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E21, from v4.1b E24)
E22: a working model only; the narrator certifies no pattern, edge, cause, Corridor or Node (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E22, from v4.1b E25)
E23: wonder without punishment; no new Mechanica (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E23, from v4.1b E26)

E26 states in advance the window, the place, what they will watch for, and what counts as a miss; prepare people, never prevent (source: reports/B01_E15_E33_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE_FALSIFICATION_PASS_2026-09-23.md; CC §3.2; S1.T1.B01.A2.E26)

E29 uses pressure zone, never drift; nothing places the pressure at the camp or the swamp; restraint is chosen and shown sound, and the laughter is never narrated as the cause of the fall (source: VAA §3 T6; S1.T1.B01.A2.E29)

E28: recognition / instinctive safety; no romance episode, no mechanics lesson, no Elisabet biography; the revocation reaches the page as Elisabet has it, and nobody says who decided (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E28, from v4.1b E30)
E30: the night succeeds and is not attacked; Lacuna is a cameo only (the unnamed musician) (source: S1.T1.B01.A2.E30, from v4.1b E31; VAA §3 T8; BC-LACUNA-CAMEO)
